Name: Wind Effects
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Wind Effects

[size=3]Wind now blows through Stardew Valley. Your crops, grass, trees, fruit trees, and bushes will sway when blown by a breeze.[/size][/size]

Examples:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xwNVCuF.gif[/img]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/PNFzLAM.gif[/img]﻿

[size=5]Details:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]By default, the wind will be enabled on 50% of days. Change the config setting to a different number (between 0 and 1) to control this. 0.5 = 50%.[/size]
[*][size=3]When it's a windy day in SDV, wind will be enabled regardless of the above setting. It'll also spawn more, faster wind.[/size]
[*][size=3]When wind is enabled, it'll change direction occasionally.[/size]
[/list]

[size=3]This mod affects the local player only. In multiplayer, you won't affect other players if you have it installed.[/size]

[size=6][size=3][size=6][size=3][size=3][size=4]Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.[/size][size=4]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place the WindEffects folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.
